localizer_attention: none; bounded line attention from the shared encoding

score_definition.meaning: LLM confidence that the change fixes a vulnerability; not severity or human confirmation

source_data_statistics.association_rule: released CSV row supplies the before/after association; no parser/name/change-type classification filter
source_data_statistics.label_provenance: score>=3 repair-before target=1 and repair-after target=0; confidence-based repair labels, not manual ground truth

split_protocol.grouping: transitive union of CVE, fix commit, repair link and whitespace-normalized source (including counterparts)
split_protocol.commit_references: repository-qualified shortest observed compatible hash prefix; original commit_id preserved

source_data_statistics.classification_weight_rule: Train negatives / positives; same BCE for all three methods

bounded_attention.head: zero-initialized Linear(hidden_size,1); no global RNG advance
bounded_attention.inference: single source only; no Diff or independently predicted localizer
bounded_attention.cross_line_tokens: conserve one token mass across its physical-line memberships

context.global_mean: valid code tokens; cross-line tokens counted once
context.initialization: W=0; U=random; V=0; no global RNG advance
